# `packs/`

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED by cargo xtask gen from docs/contributing/repo-layout.md's area tables; do not edit -->

This area's contract, from [Repo layout](../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#area-contracts).

- **Owns:** kinds, relations, hints, languages, image roles, extractor and linker declarations, lenses, questions, rules, decision kinds, suggestions, prompts, stages, evals, pack tests.
- **May depend on:** the kernel's vocabulary and the `code` pack.
- **Must not:** code or executable files; other packs except `code` (an out-of-tree pack may also require any built-in pack).
- **How to test it:** `tests/packs.rs` (validation, the inward-only rule); `planroom doctor --pack` on each; each pack's scenario tests.

Read first, from [Repo layout](../docs/contributing/repo-layout.md#read-first-per-area):

- **Sections:** [What a pack is](../docs/contributing/architecture.md#what-a-pack-is); [The v0.1 packs](../docs/contributing/architecture.md#the-v01-packs); [Lenses and questions](../docs/contributing/architecture.md#lenses-and-questions); [A decision kind](../docs/contributing/architecture.md#a-decision-kind).
- **Records:** [DR-9](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-9-packs-are-data-built-in-extractors-and-linkers-are-declared-by-packs), [DR-15](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-15-lenses-with-flow-a-dedicated-path-lens-and-question-pipelines), [DR-46](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-46-pack-data-tables-and-typed-emits), [DR-62](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-62-the-pack-set-is-workspace-state), [DR-63](../docs/contributing/decisions.md#dr-63-decision-kinds-express-v01s-kinds-as-data).
- **Scenarios:** S2, S10.

## Layout

No pack directory yet: each built-in pack (`code/`, `plan/`, `observability/`, `release/`, `artifacts/`, `machines/`) gets its own in M1. `README.md` is the page for users.
